description: Fetch the comments on one post, up to 100 a page: each comment's text, author (name, headline, profile), published_at, like_count, reply_count and its own `url`, which opens the post at that comment. With `comment_url`, the replies to one comment. Use this to see who engages with a post and what they say. Give exactly one of `url` or `comment_url`. Costs 7 credits, cached or not; a failed call is refunded.

comment_url.description: A comment's URL, as LinkedIn's "Copy link to comment" gives it: the replies to that comment.

cursor.description: The `meta.next_cursor` from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

fresh.description: Skip the cache and fetch now. Charged normally. Not available on trial credits — buy any pack to unlock it.

sort.description: Most relevant first, or newest first.

url.description: The post's URL, as for linkedin/post.

name: get_linkedin_post_comments
title: Get the comments on a LinkedIn post
